method: Direct item-body inspection of fifteen consecutive letters in the user-supplied Kehot publisher scan. PDF pages 438-450 were rendered and visually checked; page 451 was additionally checked to confirm the boundary after the fifteenth letter. Page-resolved extracted text supported bounded research paraphrases. No blocked crawler was used.
identity_relation: One identity (ד׳תרנו) was established directly from the visible page heading where the conservative index omitted it; fourteen existing locator-only identities were enriched in place.

evidence_family_dedup.counting_rule: Both letters repeat the previously inspected open-book concentration method. They add contextual witnesses but are not counted as independent methods or independent evidence families.
The immediate-launch instructions continue the already inspected Melbourne girls-school correspondence and are not counted as a separate school project.

verification_scope: Fifteen letter bodies were inspected across PDF pages 438-450. Incoming letters, cited works, institutional records, school reports, financial records, clinical contexts, halachic sources and later outcomes were not independently inspected.
rights_note: Only bounded non-verbatim research paraphrases and exact locators were recorded; no protected letter was copied in full.
quality_note: All propositions are source-grounded paraphrases. Shared Evidence Families, secretary signatures, anonymous recipients, fragments, editorial completions, manuscript-note status, telegram layers and uninspected cross-references remain explicitly limited.
